newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.

text.p: Eight stocks rose, four fell and three were flat in 6.7-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Wednesday with the WIG 20 index closing at 1,573.5 points, 0.7 percent lower than at the regular session.
The remaining eight stocks did not trade.
NFI units fell 0.7 percent to 147.5 zlotys in a 19.5-million-zloty turnover.
In comparison to Wednesday's main market fixing 12 stocks fell and three rose, with NFI units down three percent.
